title: 'Mushoku Tensei III: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu' Part 2 Announced for 2027
content: • The 14th and final episode of Mushoku Tensei III: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 ) television anime announced on Sunday that its second part is scheduled for 2027. • Produced by Studio Bind, the 23-episode first season aired in split cours in Winter 2021 and Fall 2021 .

title: One Piece Confirms 2027 Return for New Episodes After Season Finale
content: One Piece has officially come to an end for the year, and has now confirmed it’s going to be returning for new episodes of the TV anime in 2027. One Piece ushered in an entirely new era of the anime’s production this year.

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Cour 2 Officially Announced
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 anime announced a Cour 2 after Episode 14 finished airing on September 27. The anime entered its darkest episodes yet with the introduction of future Rudeus and his diary , with the latest episode concluding the arc.

title: One Piece Anime to Continue in 2027, Finished for This Year After Episode 1180
content: ONE PIECE TV anime announced a 2027 return following the release of Episode 1180 , this year’s final episode, on September 27. The anime has concluded its run for this year, having returned after a 3-month break on April 5.
